Several hours to several days (the Night Harpies only appear at night and not every night)

After the {wiki:The Order of the Lion Quest|Order of the Lion}, King {npc:Kesar the Younger} entrusts you with a family secret: a writ kept beneath Bounac cathedral. With it you go to the mysterious **Isle of Ada**, help the Bounac expedition and the last knights of the Order of the Stag, hunt Night Harpies, clear the bastion and defeat the {creature:Court Warlock}, the mage who turned the Stags into Raubritters. You receive {item:The Broken Sword of Eldoran Etzel}, the {item:Brass-Shod Chest (Order of the Stag)}, the second addon of the Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits and the achievements **Bastard** and **King's Council**.

The quest depends on Tibia's day/night cycle (1 Tibia day = 1 real hour). {npc:Kesar the Younger} is only in the throne room **during the day** (roughly between hh:15 and hh:45 of each real hour); at night he is in his chambers one floor below. {creature:Night Harpy|Night Harpies} only appear **at night**.
The Isle of Ada is confusing: it has many stairs, doors and {spell:Levitate} spots. Follow the coordinates step by step and memorise the route.
Always carry the {item:Obsidian Knife}: Night Harpy beaks only count if you skin them yourself, so it is best to skin every corpse you kill.
For the Court Warlock, the first player to enter the lever room has the Raubritters spawning at their position for the whole fight: send the **Knight** in first.

If you are going to do the optional missions, collect the {item:Tender Venison} (from the island's {creature:Stag|Stags}) and the salvage parts (from the island's minibosses or the Market) along the way.
Everything starts in Bounac, the Order of the Lion's island. Since you have already done the Order of the Lion Quest, you have access to the whole city and the castle.
Go to **Edron** and look for the small boat **north** of the mountain pass (marked spot). That is the way to travel to **Bounac**, the island between Thais and Meriana. You need level 250 to enter.

To return from Bounac to the mainland, go back to where you disembarked and take the boat back to Edron (the wiki does not document this return). Alternatively, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple.
Go up to the throne room

Use the castle **elevator**, the shortcut you learnt about in the Order of the Lion (it is at the end of the ramp to the **south**, on the floor below the throne room, and it also lets you leave the castle). Alternatively, go up to the **3rd floor** by the stairs where {npc:Onfroi} stands during the day, head **north** and then **west** to the {npc:Bounac Guard} and go up **2 more floors** to the throne room, where {npc:Kesar the Younger} is.
1. Etzel Writ — the secret beneath the cathedral

Kesar sent his best knights to the Isle of Ada aboard the Emmanuelle, the flagship, but they were never heard from again. Before sending you after them, he asks you to recover a family document kept in a sealed room beneath the cathedral.

During the **day**, talk to {npc:Kesar the Younger} in the throne room. Say {key:hi} and {key:help} (you can ask about {key:problem} first to hear the story). He tells you that beneath the cathedral there is a sealed room, guarded for centuries by a warlock, with a chest containing a writ of great importance to the Etzel family, and asks you to fetch it from the holy rooms directly above.
Go to Bounac's **cathedral**, on the city's **3rd floor** (the same floor as the {npc:Bounac Guard}). The chest room is beneath it.
Open the hole with the Frozen Starlight
In the cathedral, place the {item:Frozen Starlight} on the **stand**. This opens the hole leading to the sealed room below. Go down through it.
Also have the {item:Pick} in your backpack: the spoiler lists it as a requirement for the quest, without saying exactly where you use it.

In the room below, open the **frozen chest**. Inside is the Etzel family **writ**. The wiki does not describe the exit from this room: go back up the way you came down to the cathedral (bring a {item:Rope} just in case) and leave the cathedral for the castle.

Go back to the throne room (during the day) and talk to {npc:Kesar the Younger}: {key:hi}, {key:help} and {key:yes}. He reveals the family secret and asks you to take the writ with you and show it to Captain **Banner**, leader of the expedition. The Isle of Ada is not on the maps: since Bounac's harbour is still in chaos, you have to use a small boat to the **south**, next to the old fisherman's hut.
Do not throw the writ away: you will need it on the Isle of Ada.
2. Isle of Ada — from the beach to the bastion
The Isle of Ada is full of monsters and confusing: many stairs, doors and Levitate spots. At night, the Night Harpy raids make it even more dangerous.

Leave the castle (by the elevator: go down to the floor below the throne room and follow the ramp **south**) and go to the coast **south** of Bounac castle, next to the old fisherman's hut. Inside a small fishing boat there is a **rope**: click on it and you are transported to the **Isle of Ada**.
Rope in the fishing boat (to the Isle of Ada)
Talking to Second In Command Demeron

On the Isle of Ada, talk to {npc:Second In Command Demeron}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:tell} and answer {key:yes} three times. He ends up believing that Kesar sent you and gives you permission to enter the **mines** to the **north-west**.
Enter the mines to the **north-west** and explore them. When you reach the marked spot, your Quest Log is updated.
Spot that updates the Quest Log
On this first trip through the mines you reach the first camp, where {npc:Lieutenant Harlan} is: that is where you do the optional mission *Supplies for the Steadfast* (section 6).
Go back to the entrance and go up the stairs
Go back to the entrance (next to {npc:Second In Command Demeron}). You now have access to the stairs: go up at the marked spot to start the route to the castle.
Continue to the marked spot and use {spell:Levitate} **up**.
Go up the stairs at the marked spot.
Go to the castle **gates**. If they are **open**, go in and head straight to {npc:Guard Captain Hartford}. If they are **closed**, follow the next step.

Use {spell:Levitate} **down** twice (first and second marked spots), go up the stairs at the third spot and again at the fourth spot, and enter the NPC area through the marked **door**. You reach {npc:Guard Captain Hartford}.
If you still cannot open the doors at this stage, or if you want to open the gates, use the next step.

From the gates, use {spell:Levitate} **down** to the **south** of them. Then levitate **up** three times (at the next three marked spots), levitate **down** at the last spot, go up the stairs and click the **two chain mechanisms** that keep the gate locked. Both have to be clicked almost at the same time.
Levitate down; then go up the stairs
A quick player can do it alone; at lower levels you may need more than one person (one on each mechanism).

If you have a {item:Repair Kit For Boats} (dropped by {creature:Clavius}, the bastion's miniboss; also sold on the Market), use it on the **small boat in the south-west** of the Isle of Ada. You have a chance of being teleported to the **small boat in the north** of the island, already close to the bastion. It can fail and you may need to try a few times; the kit **is not used up**.
Small boat in the south-west (use the Repair Kit For Boats here)
Small boat in the north of the island (arrival)

The bastion is under siege: by day by the warlock's cursed knights, by night by the Night Harpies. The guard captain only lets you go up to Eldoran if you prove that you helped him against the harpies.
Talk to {npc:Guard Captain Hartford}: {key:hi}, {key:business}, {key:explain} and {key:yes}. He asks you for 20 {item:Night Harpy Beak|Night Harpy Beaks} as proof that you have killed harpies.
If you say {key:winged}, he explains that the harpies have a nest far to the **south** of the island, somewhere in the mountains.

{creature:Night Harpy|Night Harpies} only appear **at night** (Tibia time), as part of a **raid**, and **not every night**. Once the raid starts it lasts several hours, but even so they only appear during the night. Hunt them on the Isle of Ada.
During the raid the island fills up with enemies. Night Harpies attack in packs and in melee: do not pull more than you can handle.
Use the {item:Obsidian Knife} on every Night Harpy corpse you kill: you have a **chance** of getting a {item:Night Harpy Beak}. Repeat until you have **20 beaks skinned by you**.
Buying beaks on the Market or from other players does **not** advance the quest: each character has to skin their own.

Go back to {npc:Guard Captain Hartford} and say {key:hi}, {key:news} and {key:yes}. He gives you access to the **upper floor**, where {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious} is. The beaks are **not** removed from your inventory.
Access to the bastion's upper floor
4. Clearing the castle — Eldoran the Ambitious
Go up the stairs at the two marked spots. The door to {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious} is **hidden behind a tapestry**: use a **weapon** on the tapestry to break it and go through the door.
Talk to {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious}: {key:hi}, {key:word}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He asks you to deal with some **bodies** scattered around the castle.

Go down from Eldoran's floor to the bodies' floor (**2 floors above ground**, 3 below Eldoran). There are **three bodies**, all on that floor, next to burning piles. Unlike normal corpses (facing west), these face **right** (east). Use each of them ("Use").
Go back to {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious} and say {key:hi}, {key:news} and {key:yes}.

The Court Warlock controls the former knights of the Order of the Stag, now Raubritters. This is the only part of the quest that really calls for a good team (or a very strong character: 600+ recommended solo).
Ask {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious} for another {key:mission}. He asks you to put an end to the {creature:Court Warlock}.
Go down to the Tamed Frazzlemaws' cellar
Go down a few floors to the cellar with the {creature:Tamed Frazzlemaw|Tamed Frazzlemaws} (they neither move nor attack). You can now get through the doors.
Crossing the Blood Gorge to the west tower
Cross the **Blood Gorge** (1 floor underground) and go up into the **west tower** at the marked spot. Keep climbing the tower to {npc:Captain Marie-Denise Banner}'s floor (**3 floors above ground**).
Way up to the west tower
In the tower, talk to {npc:Captain Marie-Denise Banner}: {key:hi} and {key:wall}. She gives you access to the teleport hidden in the wall.
Click the marked **wall**: the teleport takes you to the **lever room**, from where the lever takes the team to the fight against the {creature:Court Warlock}.
Teleport wall to the lever room
The **first player to enter** the lever room has the Raubritters spawning **at their position** for the whole fight. Make sure the **Knight** goes in first.

The fight starts with continuous waves of Raubritters, each type immune to one element. Keep killing them. If your area damage is not enough, focus on one target at a time so that you **never have four Raubritters of the same type alive at the same time**: if that happens, they turn into a stronger version that hits much harder.
They fight at range and keep away from the Knight
{spell:Chivalrous Challenge} does not work in boss rooms, so the Energised Raubritters, which keep their distance from the Knight, are hard to catch.

From time to time **all players are teleported** to different spots in the room. The room has normal floor and areas of **special terrain**, which look visibly different. **Do not walk on the special terrain**: each step deals a lot of **death** damage.
After each teleport, look carefully at the floor before you move.
Phase 2: Falcon Paladins and Falcon Knights

After a few waves, the room fills up with {creature:Falcon Paladin|Falcon Paladins} and {creature:Falcon Knight|Falcon Knights}, and the special terrain **disappears**: from here on you can walk freely around the room. Kill all the minions.
When all the minions are dead, the {creature:Court Warlock} appears. He spawns with **less health**, depending on how the fight went up to that point. Finish him off.

The wiki **does not document** how to leave the Court Warlock's room. If you cannot find an exit after the fight, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} (Daily Reward or Store) to go to your temple and return to {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious} the same way as before: the boat from Edron to Bounac, the rope in the fishing boat south of the castle to the Isle of Ada, the route from section 2 to the bastion (or the {item:Repair Kit For Boats} shortcut), and the stairs from section 4 up to the upper floor.
The {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} does not work in No-Logout zones or while you have a **Logout Block** or **Protection Zone Block**: wait for the combat block to wear off before using it.
Hand in the mission to Eldoran

Go back to {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious} and say {key:hi} and {key:news}. You receive {item:The Broken Sword of Eldoran Etzel} and the achievement **Bastard**. The quest page also lists the {item:Brass-Shod Chest (Order of the Stag)} as a reward (the wiki does not say at exactly which point you receive it).
Brass-Shod Chest (Order of the Stag), with its animation when used
The Broken Sword of Eldoran Etzel, Brass-Shod Chest (Order of the Stag) and achievement Bastard
6. Optional missions on the Isle of Ada
Two extra missions you can do while you are on the island.
On your first visit, as you cross the mines you reach the first camp. Talk to {npc:Lieutenant Harlan}: {key:hi}, {key:yes}, {key:yes} and {key:no}. He opens a path to the **north-east**.

Offer {npc:Lieutenant Harlan} your help (the wiki does not give the exact keyword) and he asks for 20 {item:Tender Venison} to supply the camp. The {creature:Stag|Stags} on the Isle of Ada drop Tender Venison fairly often; it can also be bought on the Market. Hand them in and you receive **10,000 experience**.
Emmanuelle's Boat Repair: parts for Demeron

{npc:Second In Command Demeron} needs parts to repair the ship. Collect the parts in the table (each one drops from a Raubritter miniboss on the island; all are sold on the Market) and hand them over: {key:hi} and {key:spares} (that is the word he himself highlights in his greeting; the wiki does not show the rest of the dialogue). In return you receive {item:The Mariner's Compass From the Antoinette}.
Against {creature:Michael the Stalwart}, keep him moving: if he stands still, he gains charges (up to 10) and can hit about 50% harder.
7. Back to Bounac: second addon and King's Council

The wiki **does not document** the return trip from the Isle of Ada to Bounac. First look for the boat you arrived on (next to {npc:Second In Command Demeron}'s camp). If there is no return trip, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} (Daily Reward or Store) to go to your temple and return to Bounac by the boat north of Edron's mountain pass. Demeron even says that the expedition, in its current state, *has no way off the island*.
The {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} does not work in No-Logout zones or with a **Logout Block** or **Protection Zone Block**: get out of combat first.

During the **day**, go up to the throne room and talk to {npc:Kesar the Younger}: {key:hi} and {key:help}. He gives you the **second addon** of the {wiki:Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits|Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits} and the achievement **King's Council**.
Royal Bounacean Advisor with the second addon (male)
Royal Bounacean Advisor with the second addon (female)

According to the achievement page, **King's Council** is awarded to those who have **both addons** of the outfit. The first addon is obtained in the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest} (kill {creature:Megasylvan Yselda} with the Saplings alive and talk to {npc:John (Bounac)}). The base outfit also comes from the Adventures of Galthen Quest.
Second addon of the Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits and King's Council achievement

Isle of Ada minibosses (all Raubritters): {creature:Clavius} ({coord:33862,32106,4}), {creature:Michael the Stalwart} ({coord:33863,32115,0}), {creature:Adlerauge} ({coord:33857,32167,2}) and {creature:Overseer Osverger} ({coord:33878,32121,2}), who only appears at night and disappears during the day if not killed. {creature:Clavius} and {creature:Adlerauge} (like the {creature:Raubritter Chastener|Raubritter Chasteners} and {creature:Raubritter Marksman|Raubritter Marksmen}) drop {item:Stag Parchment}; only {creature:Clavius} drops the {item:Repair Kit For Boats} (boat shortcut within the island, see section 2).

The {creature:Tamed Frazzlemaw|Tamed Frazzlemaws} in the bastion's cellar give the **Battlefrazzle** mount: use a {item:Marinated Sturgeon} on them, which only drops from the {creature:Raubritter Skirmisher|Raubritter Skirmishers} in the bastion's kitchen ({coord:33863,32112,3}). It is not part of the quest.
You keep the {item:Night Harpy Beak|Night Harpy Beaks} after showing the 20 to Hartford.

The {creature:Court Warlock} can be fought again after the cooldown; the wiki does not give its duration. Using a {item:Twisted Marionette} (his rare loot, sold on the Market) resets the cooldown immediately.
The Court Warlock is the only source of the Stag set pieces (Stag Helmet, Plate, Robe, Legs, Shinguards, Boots, Footwraps, Shield, Spellbook and Scrolls), all very rare.
